title: Two-Point Dependent Wild Bootstrap for Weakly Dependent Estimating Equations
abstract: arXiv:2609.32369v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper develops a general two-point dependent wild bootstrap (DWB) for weakly dependent estimating equations. Its key feature is that the two-point marginal distribution and the latent serial dependence specification can be chosen separately. The construction combines a normalized two-point distribution with a stationary latent Gaussian process via a Gaussian copula transformation, includes dependent Rademacher and Mammen multipliers, and nests the classical iid two-point wild bootstrap as the serially independent case. The induced multiplier autocovariances determine the lag weights in a corresponding heteroskedasticity- and autocorrelation-consistent (HAC) covariance estimator, which coincides exactly with the conditional covariance of the bootstrap estimating-equation sum. translated_title: 弱依赖估计方程的两点依赖野自助法
translated_abstract: 本文针对弱依赖估计方程发展了一种一般化的两点依赖野自助法（DWB）。其关键特征在于两点边际分布与潜在的序列依赖设定可以分开选择。该构造通过高斯copula变换将归一化的两点分布与平稳的潜在高斯过程相结合，包含了依赖的Rademacher乘子和Mammen乘子，并将经典的独立同分布两点野自助法作为序列独立的特殊情形包含其中。由此产生的乘子自协方差决定了相应的异方差与自相关一致（HAC）协方差估计量中的滞后权重，该估计量与自助估计方程和的条件协方差完全吻合。我们通过证明匹配HAC估计量一致地估计了……（摘要在此处截断），从而为渐近线性估计量建立了一阶自助有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于弱依赖估计方程的两点依赖野自助法，通过高斯copula将两点分布与潜在平稳高斯过程结合，使边际分布与序列依赖结构可以分开设定，并证明了对渐近线性估计量的一阶自助有效性，同时其乘子自协方差与匹配的HAC协方差估计量完全一致。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general two-point dependent wild bootstrap for weakly dependent estimating equations, which combines a normalized two-point distribution with a stationary latent Gaussian process via a Gaussian copula so that the marginal distribution and serial dependence can be chosen separately, and establishes first-order bootstrap validity for asymptotically linear estimators with the multiplier autocovariances matching a HAC covariance estimator exactly.
